We have an automatic lift to ease the vessel in and out of the water. Hop in the kayak and enjoy the warm sun and gentle breezes from a new vantage point. All kayaks are beginner friendly, come with safety equipment, PFD, and a safety lesson. We have a 17ft aluminum Smokercraft canoe which can accommodate 2 adults and 2 children.
